summary: Perpetua Resources Corp. (filer) filed an 8-K (Item 1.01) disclosing a second amendment to an engineering, procurement, and construction management services agreement with Hatch Ltd. for the Stibnite Gold Project. The amendment establishes terms for Hatch to supply autoclaves, flash vessels, and vent gas cyclones for a fixed price of $32.1 million. This is a routine project procurement contract, not a special situation. No board recommendation, deal premium, or strategic corporate event is involved.
